text: cli-builder Update mode steps 13.1/13 and 14.1 tell to commit before copier update, but a worker may not run git commit (hook). In SEMKIT-065 I staged the tree (git add -A) and ran copier.run_update through Python with only the dirty-tree guard off: copier reads the index (git write-tree), so nothing is lost. The skill could name this way, or Antagor could allow a WIP commit for copier.
note: Sent to cli-generator as an idea.
